name: one-a-day
description: One m0saic template a day, written by an AI agent and built in public. A third-party template repo for Mosaic Desktop and the m0saic CLI.

scripts.build: node tools/check-freeze.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node dist/gen-template-manifest.js && node tools/check-registry.mjs && node tools/check-layout.mjs && node tools/check-why.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:contract && npm run check:deps
scripts.test:pipeline:e2e: node pipeline/e2e-fake-day.mjs && node pipeline/e2e-fake-day.mjs no-ship && node pipeline/e2e-fake-day.mjs tamper

//dependencies: The @m0saic/* substrate is on npm. The 0.x ranges (types, platform,
template-utils) track the m0saic CLI line; the language packages (dsl,
dsl-stdlib) version on their own. AUTHOR MODE (build / test / lint) is
`npm install && npm run verify` — no monorepo checkout, no file: links.
USING the repo needs no install at all: dist/ and template-manifest.json
are COMMITTED (the daily run rebuilds them), so the app (Templates ->
Add source) and the CLI (--template-repo) load dist/index.js as-is, and
the host resolves @m0saic/* from its own module tree at load time.
